title: adhatoda leptantha
intro: Adhatoda leptantha, commonly known as Vasa, is a plant species belonging to the family Acanthaceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, digestive problems, and skin ailments, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation, improving circulation, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Adhatoda leptantha include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating conditions like bronchitis, asthma, and fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, such as vasicine and vasicinone, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
